module.Title: Model an Inventory Item
module.Teaching: A small class can group an item's name and quantity into one meaningful object.
PredictionOptions: Classes can hold only one value
module.PredictionExplanation: The object keeps related item data together.
module.DebugPrompt: In property declarations, the data type comes before the property name.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the Item class with Name and Quantity. Use these exact identifiers: get, set.
module.TransferPrompt: Create a Weapon class with Name and Damage properties. Use these exact identifiers: get, set.
module.PreviewMessage: Inventory entries can now become structured objects.
